dependencies.scope: Use Kloz's versioned platform operations; userspace provides only capabilities it can safely implement.
Compose application-owned lifecycle callbacks without turning CO into a scheduler.
Feed bounded health observations from completed service work; no automatic reset authority.
Requires an upstream ARCH_TARGET_ELBRUS enum and a reviewed E2K BSP before hardware telemetry integration.
Consume versioned build and capability descriptions; production E2K code generation remains with MCST LCC.
Potential read-only target/build evidence report; the Windows GUI is not part of the E2K runtime.
Project the manifest and target-validation evidence into the ecosystem registry.

boundaries: A host build does not prove E2K compiler, ABI, sysroot, runtime or hardware compatibility.
Only a compiler that defines __e2k__ may be used by the E2K toolchain file.
No undocumented CPU-generation macros, ISA flags, privileged registers, MMIO, voltage or clock controls are assumed.
PMU, cache, thermal and supply measurements require separately validated OS or board providers.
ReaperCripple does not yet expose ARCH_TARGET_ELBRUS; its adapter remains planned.
SAMBU's native compiler backend is experimental and is not claimed to generate E2K machine code.

verification.host_tests: Run python one.py test or CMake/CTest with GCC or Clang.
verification.target_validation: Pending MCST LCC configure/build, QEMU-e2k or native execution, and per-model hardware validation.
